description: Test suite for auditing seam classifications within the project, focusing on various source files related to cron jobs, subagents, and their communications, using 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates a cron isolated agent turn, registers context, runs agent, delivers payloads, and builds session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the cron service, ensuring data is loaded, recomputing, persisting state, and scheduling the next run.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Spawns a subagent directly, handling gateway calls, registering subagent run, and emitting lifecycle event.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run, resolves context, captures reply, emits end hook, persists state, and runs announce flow.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Sets up parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening to agent events and requesting heartbeat.
